title: Access and use Microsoft 365 Copilot
issue: You need to access or request Microsoft 365 Copilot
resolution_html:
1. Check that your department has approved Microsoft 365 Copilot licensing
  2. Confirm your assigned employee licence and data permissions
  3. Open the approved Microsoft 365 Copilot application after activation

For a problem, contact askIT and include the service and any error shown
